dialogue.content: こんにちは
dialogue.English: Hello.

dialogue.content: よろしくお願いします
dialogue.English: Thank you for seeing me.

dialogue.content: よろしくお願いいたします色々大変でしたよね
dialogue.English: It's nice to meet you, too. You’ve been through a lot, haven’t you?

dialogue.content: いいえ、こちらこそ
dialogue.English: No, the pleasure is mine.

dialogue.content: 時間は15:30までで大丈夫ですか？
dialogue.English: Is it okay if we go until 3:30?

dialogue.content: 私は16:00まで大丈夫です
dialogue.English: I’m fine until 4:00 PM.

dialogue.content: はい、ギリ大丈夫です
dialogue.English: Yes, that should be just about fine.

dialogue.content: 了解です。
dialogue.English: Understood.

dialogue.content: ではお願い致します。
dialogue.English: Well then, let's begin.

dialogue.content: はい、お願いいたしますでは、ロープレ開始します
dialogue.English: Yes, thank you. Let’s start the role-play.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: こんにちは、相談員ですよろしくお願いいたします
dialogue.English: Hello, I'm the counselor. It's nice to meet you.

dialogue.content: はい、よろしくお願いします
dialogue.English: Yes, nice to meet you too.

dialogue.content: 今日はどのようなご相談でしょうか？
dialogue.English: What would you like to talk about today?

dialogue.content: なんかどうしようもないことなんですが、、もやっとしてることがありまして。
dialogue.English: It’s something I can’t really do anything about, but there’s something that’s been nagging at me.

dialogue.content: そうなんですねしょもないことなどと言わずお話し聞かせて下さい
dialogue.English: I see. Please don't worry about it being trivial. Tell me what's on your mind.

dialogue.content: 前に会社を辞めた子がいるんですけど、その子のことが気になっています。
dialogue.English: There's a woman who quit the company a while ago, and I can't stop thinking about her.

dialogue.content: その子は会社の悪口や夫(同じ職場です)の悪口を散々行って辞めたんですが、
dialogue.English: She badmouthed the company and my husband (who works at the same place) a lot before quitting.

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Mmm-hmm.

dialogue.content: 今でも他支店の同期の子達と繋がってるみたいで、まだ夫の悪口を言ってるみたいなんです
dialogue.English: It seems she's still in touch with our colleagues at other branches, and apparently, she's still badmouthing my husband.

dialogue.content: 夫の悪口だけでなく多分私のことも
dialogue.English: And not just my husband, probably me too.

dialogue.content: お辞めになった方の事が気になっておられるのは
dialogue.English: So you're concerned about this person who left...

dialogue.content: なんか腹立ちます
dialogue.English: It just makes me so angry.

dialogue.content: 夫さんの事だけでなく、会社や相談者さんの悪口をおっしゃられてると
dialogue.English: She's saying bad things not just about your husband, but about the company and you as well.

dialogue.content: はい。
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: それは、かなり腹立たしいですね
dialogue.English: That must be incredibly infuriating.

dialogue.content: そうなんです、先月異動してそのことを知りました
dialogue.English: It is. I found out about it after I transferred last month.

dialogue.content: お辞めになった方と繋がりがあるかたから漏れてくるのですね
dialogue.English: So the information is leaking from people who are still in contact with the person who quit.

dialogue.content: そうなんです。
dialogue.English: That’s right.

dialogue.content: それで今いる子たちは私たち夫婦が来るなら辞めるとか言ってたらしくて。
dialogue.English: Apparently, the people here were saying they’d quit if my husband and I came.

dialogue.content: 夫と直接話してその子達もわかったみたいですが
dialogue.English: It seems they understood after talking to my husband directly, though.

dialogue.content: ごめんなさい、相談者さんご夫妻がどこにいかれるのですか？
dialogue.English: I'm sorry, where were you and your husband going?

dialogue.content: あ、すいません
dialogue.English: Oh, sorry.

dialogue.content: 以前は那覇にいて、先月福岡に異動してきたんです
dialogue.English: We were in Naha before, and we transferred to Fukuoka last month.

dialogue.content: で、那覇の悪口言って辞めた子が、福岡の同期の子に私たちの悪口を言ってたって感じです
dialogue.English: So, the person who quit after badmouthing the Naha office was telling our colleagues in Fukuoka bad things about us. That's the situation.

dialogue.content: 社内の移動ではなく、会社自体の移動なのですね
dialogue.English: So it wasn't a move within the company, but to a different company?

dialogue.content: 支店の異動ですね
dialogue.English: It's a branch transfer.

dialogue.content: そういうことなのですね
dialogue.English: Oh, I see.

dialogue.content: で
dialogue.English: And...

dialogue.content: はい、そうです
dialogue.English: Yes, that's right.

dialogue.content: 福岡にいらっしゃる悪口を聞いた方が鵜呑みにされてるということなんですね
dialogue.English: So the people in Fukuoka who heard those remarks took them at face value, is that right?

dialogue.content: そうですね、今は誤解はとけたようですが
dialogue.English: Yes, it seems the misunderstanding has been cleared up now, though.

dialogue.content: 誤解はとかれたのですね
dialogue.English: The misunderstanding has been cleared up.

dialogue.content: そうみたいです。
dialogue.English: It seems so.

dialogue.content: 一番腹立たしいのは、辞めていった方の腹立たしさですかね
dialogue.English: The most infuriating part is the behavior of the person who left, right?

dialogue.content: 私は育休で会社には言ってないので直接福岡の子たちから話は聞いていませんが、夫が言うには誤解は解けたようです
dialogue.English: I’m on parental leave and not going to the office, so I haven’t heard directly from the people in Fukuoka, but according to my husband, the misunderstanding has been cleared up.

dialogue.content: そうです。まさに。
dialogue.English: Yes, exactly.

dialogue.content: 今さらどうしようもできないことはわかってるんですが。。
dialogue.English: I know there’s nothing I can do about it now, but...

dialogue.content: なんだか腹立たしくて
dialogue.English: It just makes me so angry.

dialogue.content: それは、腹がたって当然のことですよね
dialogue.English: It's completely natural to feel angry about that.

dialogue.content: なんていうか、卑怯ですよね
dialogue.English: It’s, how should I put it… cowardly.

dialogue.content: 言い逃げみたいな
dialogue.English: Like a hit-and-run.

dialogue.content: そうですね新しい事で色々大変でしょうに
dialogue.English: I agree. You must have so much on your plate with all the new changes.

dialogue.content: 感情的に
dialogue.English: Emotionally...

dialogue.content: はい。私よりも夫の方が堪えてたかもしれません
dialogue.English: Yes. It may have been even harder on my husband than on me.

dialogue.content: 振り回されてしまう感じですよねまさに、言い逃げですね
dialogue.English: It feels like you're being jerked around. It's exactly like a hit-and-run.

dialogue.content: かき回すだけかきまわして！
dialogue.English: Just stirring up trouble and leaving!

dialogue.content: そうなんです、、
dialogue.English: Exactly...

dialogue.content: 那覇の支店もそれでだいぶ荒れましたし、、
dialogue.English: The Naha branch was thrown into turmoil because of it, too.

dialogue.content: 夫さんも良く耐えてこられましたね
dialogue.English: Your husband has endured so much.

dialogue.content: そうですね。。
dialogue.English: Yes, he has...

dialogue.content: 那覇でももっと荒れる様なことがあったのですね
dialogue.English: So there were other things that caused trouble in Naha as well?

dialogue.content: 会社への不満を散々言い散らして
dialogue.English: She went on and on, spreading complaints about the company.

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Mmm-hmm.

dialogue.content: 他の2人も辞めました
dialogue.English: Two other people quit as well.

dialogue.content: まぁ元々辞める人だったのかもしれませんが
dialogue.English: Well, maybe they were planning to quit anyway, but...

dialogue.content: なんだかその子の悪口に引っ張られた感は否めない、、
dialogue.English: I can't shake the feeling that they were influenced by her negativity...

dialogue.content: 嫌がらせの為に会社にきている感じさえしてきてしまいます
dialogue.English: It almost sounds like she was coming to work just to cause trouble.

dialogue.content: それで退職になってホッとしていたらまだ言いふらしてたっていうのでびっくり
dialogue.English: So I was relieved when she finally resigned, and then I was shocked to find out she was still spreading rumors.

dialogue.content: そうですよね
dialogue.English: I can imagine.

dialogue.content: やっといなくなってくれたのに
dialogue.English: Just when you finally thought she was gone...

dialogue.content: はぁ、、ってかんじです
dialogue.English: It's just... *sigh*... you know?

dialogue.content: 差し支えなければ、悪口とはどんな事を言いふらしておられたのですか？
dialogue.English: If you don’t mind my asking, what kinds of things was she saying?

dialogue.content: 夫のことについては、仕事の進め方が気に入らなかったみたいで、
dialogue.English: Regarding my husband, it seems she didn’t like the way he managed the work.

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Mmm-hmm.

dialogue.content: 何言ってるかわからない、とか
dialogue.English: Things like, "I can't understand what he's saying," or...

dialogue.content: これでは部下は伸びない、とか
dialogue.English: "His subordinates won't grow under him."

dialogue.content: 仕事に支障をきたすレベルの悪口ですね！
dialogue.English: Those are comments that could interfere with work!

dialogue.content: 仕事の進め方についてなら直接言ってくれれば良かったのにって
dialogue.English: If she had a problem with his work style, I wish she had just told him directly.

dialogue.content: 嫌味な影口ほど怒りになりますよね
dialogue.English: Spiteful backstabbing is the most infuriating kind, isn't it?

dialogue.content: 陰湿すぎる
dialogue.English: It's just too malicious.

dialogue.content: しかもその悪口を社内SNSで那覇の同期の子に送ってたんですよ
dialogue.English: And what's more, she was sending these messages to a colleague in Naha through the company's internal social media.

dialogue.content: それで発覚
dialogue.English: That’s how it came to light.

dialogue.content: 本当に嫌な気分でした
dialogue.English: It made me feel really awful.

dialogue.content: 社内SNSでですか！
dialogue.English: On the internal SNS?!

dialogue.content: だからバレたんです
dialogue.English: That's why she got caught.

dialogue.content: ツメが甘いというか、、
dialogue.English: I guess you could say she was sloppy...

dialogue.content: 夫はそれがわかったとき本当に苦しそうで泣いてました
dialogue.English: When my husband found out, he was in so much pain, he was crying.

dialogue.content: その人たちが辞めて、異動して新しい生活が始まるとおもったら
dialogue.English: I thought once those people left and we transferred, a new life would begin, but—

dialogue.content: こんなことがあって
dialogue.English: Then this happened.

dialogue.content: 夫さん、涙まで・・・人としても社会人としても幼すぎますね
dialogue.English: Your husband was driven to tears... That's so immature of her, both as a person and as a professional.

dialogue.content: 一番辛いのは夫なんでしょうけど、、
dialogue.English: My husband is probably the one suffering the most, but...

dialogue.content: 私は腹が立ってて
dialogue.English: I’m just so angry.

dialogue.content: どうしようもないことなのにモヤモヤしてしまって、、
dialogue.English: Even though there’s nothing I can do, I can’t shake this frustrating feeling.

dialogue.content: そうですね、夫さんが直接的に被害をこうむっているわけですからお辛かったでしょうね
dialogue.English: Yes, your husband was the direct victim, so it must have been very painful for him.

dialogue.content: それを、相談者さんが
dialogue.English: And you—

dialogue.content: はい。なので話を聴くときはなるべく感情を出さないようにしてるんですが
dialogue.English: Yes. So when I listen to him talk about it, I try not to show my emotions as much as possible.

dialogue.content: 怒りの感情は
dialogue.English: As for the anger...

dialogue.content: お話しを聞いて支えつつも、ご自身でも腹が立って子の感情をどうすればよいか！ですね
dialogue.English: While you support him by listening, you're also struggling with what to do with your own anger!

dialogue.content: そうなんですよね、、
dialogue.English: Exactly...

dialogue.content: 昼間ふとした瞬間に思い出すともやっとしてしまう、、
dialogue.English: During the day, it pops into my head at random moments and I just feel so unsettled...

dialogue.content: もやっとどころか沸々怒りがこみあげてきそうですが
dialogue.English: I imagine it's more than just feeling unsettled; it must feel like anger is boiling up inside you.

dialogue.content: はい、だからなるべく考えないようにはしてるんですけど
dialogue.English: Yes, so I try my best not to think about it.

dialogue.content: ご自身をセーブなさっておられるのですね
dialogue.English: So you’ve been holding yourself back.

dialogue.content: そうですね。。
dialogue.English: I suppose so...

dialogue.content: 新しい生活が始まろうとした矢先に苛立ちますよね
dialogue.English: It's so frustrating for this to happen just as you were about to start a new life.

dialogue.content: 出鼻をくじかれた感じですね
dialogue.English: It feels like being tripped up right at the start.

dialogue.content: せっかく終わった話だと、ホッとしたところでしたのに
dialogue.English: Just when you thought it was over and could finally relax.

dialogue.content: はい。過ぎた話にできてきたところでした
dialogue.English: Yes. We were just getting to the point where we could put it behind us.

dialogue.content: 悔しいですね！！
dialogue.English: It’s so frustrating, isn’t it!

dialogue.content: もう嫌になっちゃいます
dialogue.English: I'm so sick of it.

dialogue.content: 夫さんは今は、どんな感じでお過ごしですか？
dialogue.English: How is your husband doing these days?

dialogue.content: 出張がメインなので週のほとんどは家にいないですが、頑張ってるみたいでさ
dialogue.English: He's mostly on business trips, so he's not home most of the week, but he seems to be doing his best.

dialogue.content: です の間違いです
dialogue.English: Sorry, that was a typo for 'desu'.

dialogue.content: そうですか、それは不幸中の幸いと言うか・・
dialogue.English: I see. In a way, that might be a blessing in disguise...

dialogue.content: ただ
dialogue.English: But...

dialogue.content: 相談者さんが夫さんとご自身の二人分の感情を引き受けずにすんで少し安心しました
dialogue.English: I'm a little relieved that you don't have to bear the burden of both your husband's emotions and your own.

dialogue.content: 誤解は解けたようなのでそこは安心しました
dialogue.English: Since the misunderstanding seems to have been cleared up, I’m relieved about that part.

dialogue.content: 良かったです後はご自身の感情の行き場所ですね
dialogue.English: That's good. Now it's a matter of finding a place for your own feelings.

dialogue.content: そうですね、、
dialogue.English: Yes, you're right...

dialogue.content: 育休はいつまでかは決まっていらっしゃるのですか？
dialogue.English: Have you decided how long you’ll be on parental leave?

dialogue.content: あと半年あります
dialogue.English: I have another six months.

dialogue.content: そうですかそれまでには、腹立たしい奴の存在を心から消したいですね
dialogue.English: I see. By then, it would be ideal if that infuriating person no longer occupied any space in your mind.

dialogue.content: まぁそうですね
dialogue.English: Yes, I suppose so.

dialogue.content: 今、ふと思い出すと。とおっしゃておられましたが、頻度的にはどの位で出現してきますか？
dialogue.English: You mentioned that you find yourself suddenly remembering it. How often does that happen?

dialogue.content: 頻度は、、正確にはわかりませんがここ3日くらい子供の世話が落ち着いたときに考えたりします
dialogue.English: The frequency... I'm not exactly sure, but for the past three days or so, I've found myself thinking about it when things are calm with my child.

dialogue.content: 忙しい時ではない瞬間に思い出す感じですかね
dialogue.English: So it tends to come up in moments when you’re not busy.

dialogue.content: そうですね。落ち着いたときに。
dialogue.English: Yes, when things are calm.

dialogue.content: 移動前に悪口で振り回されたり、その人のせいで辞める感じになった方もおいでになり
dialogue.English: Before your transfer, you were jerked around by the gossip, and some people even ended up quitting because of that person.

dialogue.content: 新しい移動先で、新たな気持ちでむかえようとした新生活も、人の繋がりから出鼻をくじかれ夫さんも涙することもあり、相談者さんは、支えながらもご自身の行き場のない怒りと苛立ちに耐えられ
dialogue.English: and then, just as you were trying to start your new life fresh, you were tripped up at the start by these connections, your husband was even driven to tears, and while supporting him, you've been enduring your own anger and frustration with no outlet—

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: でも、お忙しい時間では無い時にまだ思い出してしまいお辛い感じ。ということでよろしいでしょうか？
dialogue.English: But you still find yourself remembering it when you're not busy, and it's painful. Is that a fair summary?

dialogue.content: はい、そうです
dialogue.English: Yes, that's right.

dialogue.content: 育休が終り会社の戻られるときは絶対にもう邪魔な影は感じたくないですよね
dialogue.English: When your parental leave ends and you return to the company, you definitely don’t want to feel that shadow hanging over you anymore.

dialogue.content: 忙しくなれば大丈夫かも知れません
dialogue.English: I might be okay once I get busy.

dialogue.content: そうですか考える時間がなければ大丈夫な気もなさっているのですね
dialogue.English: I see. So you feel that if you don't have time to dwell on it, you’ll be okay.

dialogue.content: そうですね。思い出すタイミングを考えてみたらそんな気がします
dialogue.English: Yes. When I think about the times I remember it, that's what it feels like.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: ここまで
dialogue.English: Up to this point...

dialogue.content: ずっと、振り回され続け嫌な思い、腹立たしさ、苛立ちと戦ってきたご相談者さまです
dialogue.English: You have been constantly jerked around and have been fighting against unpleasant feelings, anger, and frustration.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: そして夫さんの支えにもなり、育児にも引っ越しにも頑張ってこられましたよね
dialogue.English: And you've also been a support for your husband, and you've worked so hard with childcare and the move.

dialogue.content: より一層ご自身の時間を充実させ楽しむ時間が増えるといいなと感じます
dialogue.English: I feel that it would be good for you to have more time to enrich your own life and enjoy yourself.

dialogue.content: 自分の時間ですか
dialogue.English: My own time?

dialogue.content: お子さんと共に
dialogue.English: Together with your child, too.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: (時間になってしまい申し訳ないです。ながくなってしまいました。途中になりましたが終了にしますか)
dialogue.English: (I'm sorry, we're out of time. This has gone on for a while. It feels a bit unfinished, but shall we end here?)

dialogue.content: はい、お任せいたします
dialogue.English: Yes, I’ll leave it up to you.

dialogue.content: (私はギリあと15分大丈夫ですが、気持ちが悪い感じでの終了にならなければとねがいます)
dialogue.English: (I can go for another 15 minutes if needed. I just hope we don't end on an unsatisfying note.)

dialogue.content: 私も時間大丈夫です！
dialogue.English: I’m okay on time, too!

dialogue.content: (ありがとうございます。ではあと少しよろしくお願いいたします)
dialogue.English: (Thank you. Then let’s continue for a little longer.)

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: お子さんと共にでも、ご自身で少し空いた時間にでもリラックスできる時間が出来るとよいな。と感じました
dialogue.English: I felt that it would be good if you could find time to relax, whether it's with your child or by yourself during a spare moment.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: どんな事なら可能ですか？
dialogue.English: What kinds of things would be possible for you?

dialogue.content: 動画や映画を見るのは好きです
dialogue.English: I like watching videos and movies.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね！
dialogue.English: Oh, that's nice!

dialogue.content: 動画でしたら手軽に出来そうですね
dialogue.English: Watching videos sounds like something you can do easily.

dialogue.content: 子供が寝た後に見るときはあります
dialogue.English: I sometimes watch them after my child goes to sleep.

dialogue.content: 時間の有効活用されておられますね
dialogue.English: You’re making good use of your time.

dialogue.content: よく寝てくれるので助かっています
dialogue.English: They're a good sleeper, which helps a lot.

dialogue.content: そうでしたかお母さんおもいでいらっしゃる！
dialogue.English: Is that so? What a thoughtful child!

dialogue.content: 楽しています
dialogue.English: It makes things easy for me.

dialogue.content: 相談者さんも育児や家事でお疲れになりながらも時間を上手く使われておられますね
dialogue.English: Even while you're tired from childcare and housework, you're using your time very skillfully.

dialogue.content: 他の方はどうかよくわかりませんが、楽しようと思えばかなり楽できるのでマイペースにやってます
dialogue.English: I'm not sure how others do it, but I can make things pretty easy on myself if I want, so I just go at my own pace.

dialogue.content: 時間の有効活用が上手だと思います
dialogue.English: I think you're very good at using your time effectively.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: では、その上手さを利用して影に邪魔されないよう、お忙しくない時は楽しい事に打ち込んでいただけたらと思います
dialogue.English: Then, making use of that skill, I hope that when you’re not busy you can immerse yourself in enjoyable things so you won’t be bothered by that lingering “shadow.”

dialogue.content: そうですね。考える時間をつくらないようにしてみます
dialogue.English: You're right. I’ll try not to create time to dwell on it.

dialogue.content: はい、応援しておりますのでご無理なさらない程度にやってみらしてください
dialogue.English: Yes, I'll be rooting for you. Please give it a try, but don't push yourself too hard.

dialogue.content: 又、なにかありましたらお話しにお越しください
dialogue.English: If anything else comes up, please feel free to come and talk.

dialogue.content: わかりました
dialogue.English: I will.

dialogue.content: 今日はこれで終了になりますが大丈夫でしょうか？
dialogue.English: Shall we end here for today, is that okay?

dialogue.content: はい、大丈夫です
dialogue.English: Yes, that's fine.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Thank you very much.

dialogue.content: こちらこそ、お話ししてくださりありがとうございました
dialogue.English: No, thank you for sharing your story with me.

dialogue.content: (長時間ありがとうございました。また、お会い出来たらよろしくお願いいたします。)
dialogue.English: (Thank you for the long session. I look forward to seeing you again.)

dialogue.content: ありがとうこざいました！
dialogue.English: Thank you very much!

dialogue.content: ありがとございました。では、失礼いたします。
dialogue.English: Thank you. Well then, goodbye.
